content.title: Queens fire destroys home in Corona near Citi Field on opening day - ABC7 New York
content.text: Fire destroys home in Corona, Queens near Citi FieldByEyewitness News Thursday, March 26, 2026 7:37PM24/7 Coverage of Breaking News and Live EventsStream New York's #1 news - AccuWeather - original content 24/7CORONA, Queens (WABC) -- A fire tore through a home in Queens Thursday morning, prompting firefighters to shift their focus to protecting nearby buildings.The FDNY says a call came in at 10:15 a.m. for a fire on the second floor of a private dwelling on 42nd Avenue in the Corona section, just blocks from Citi Field.The fire escalated to a second alarm at 10:36 a.m. as heavy flames ripped through the home, which later suffered an interior collapse.The FDNY says five firefighters suffered minor injuries and were taken to the hospital and a civilian refused medial care.The fire was under control just before 1:30 p.m. ----------* Get Eyewitness News Delivered * More Manhattan news* Send us a news tip* Download the abc7NY app for breaking news alerts * Follow us on YouTube Submit a tip or story idea to Eyewitness NewsHave a breaking news tip or an idea for a story we should cover?
